control_script:
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Repository,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Magick,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$PesterManifest
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$env:WINIMG_TEST_MAGICK = $Magick
$transcript = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'import-exit-zero-transcript.log'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $transcript) { throw 'Control transcript already exists.' }
Start-Transcript -Path $transcript | Out-Null
try {
    Import-Module -Name $PesterManifest -RequiredVersion 5.9.1 -Force
    $result = Invoke-Pester -Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tests/Normalizer.Tests.ps1') -Output Detailed -PassThru
    $summary = [ordered]@{
        schema_version = 1
        recorded_utc = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
        control = 'Ignored scratch copy of app prefixed with exit 0; tracked application unchanged.'
        powershell_version = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()
        pester_version = (Get-Module Pester).Version.ToString()
        application_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Repository 'WinImgNormalizer.ps1') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
        copied_application_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'WinImgNormalizer.ps1') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
        test_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'tests/Normalizer.Tests.ps1') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
        result = [string]$result.Result
        total = $result.TotalCount
        passed = $result.PassedCount
        failed = $result.FailedCount
        skipped = $result.SkippedCount
        inconclusive = $result.InconclusiveCount
        not_run = $result.NotRunCount
        failed_containers = $result.FailedContainersCount
        gate_detected = ($result.Result -eq 'Failed' -and $result.TotalCount -eq 6 -and $result.FailedCount -eq 6)
    }
    $summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'import-exit-zero-result.json'),
        ($summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4), (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    if (-not $summary.gate_detected) { throw 'Import exit-zero regression escaped the test gate.' }
    'IMPORT_EXIT_ZERO_REGRESSION_DETECTED'
} finally { Stop-Transcript | Out-Null }
